title: Bus route
passage:
Does this bus stop near the science museum?
A. Yes, get off at the next stop.
B. The museum closes on Mondays.
C. I stopped reading that book.
passageZh:
這班公車會停在科學博物館附近嗎？
A. 會，在下一站下車。
B. 博物館星期一休館。
C. 我不再讀那本書了。
